experiment: PMUS NFL Sunday PRE->LIVE habitat test, 2026-09-20
status: PREREGISTERED. Written and committed BEFORE any reach, movement or recycling figure was computed for this slate.
posture: READ-ONLY / SHADOW. GET requests to the public PMUS gateway only. No credentials, no order path, no venue writes, no arming, no change to Model A or any execution system. The Gemini corrected A+B prospective shadow keeps running untouched as the control.
why_this_slate: the previous Phase-2 reach test ran 02:40-03:10 UTC when essentially no US sport was live and 176 of 229 sampled markets were NFL PREGAME for games days away. Those reach figures are valid only as a lower bound for that hour and cannot answer whether LIVE sport supplies L5-like habitat. Today's slate is the natural experiment.

slate_as_the_venue_serves_it.SNF_note: no 20:20 ET / 00:20 UTC Sunday Night Football event is present in the league feed at selection time. The SNF cohort stays DEFINED and will be reported EMPTY if no such game appears, rather than dropped.

selection_rule_fixed_in_advance.rule: per event, the markets whose mid sits nearest 0.50 within [0.30, 0.70] -- the price region L5 actually operates in -- capped at 2 per sportsMarketType family and 13 per NFL event / 9 per other event, so no family or game dominates
selection_rule_fixed_in_advance.never_uses: reach, movement, depth or any outcome variable
selection_rule_fixed_in_advance.note: re-discovery every 15 min refreshes each event's live flag, period and score, which is what makes the same-market PRE->LIVE pairing possible

cadence.why: the 8s PRE window from 15:00-17:00Z is a like-for-like control for the 8s LIVE measurement. Reach at 30/60/120s is computed ONLY on 8s rows.

cohorts_reported_separately_never_pooled: late-game / high-TTE-pressure states where sample permits
and, crosscutting, moneyline vs spread vs total vs other

preregistered_qualification_thresholds.near_qualifiers: ranked and reported with the exact failing dimension named; never silently discarded

frozen_reference.note: reach120 for both reference venues was corrected to EXCLUDE right-censored states rather than score them as misses (International 76.0 -> 80.6, Gemini 16.8 -> 24.4). The corrected figures are canonical and the same exclusion applies to every figure in this experiment.

primary_discriminator: REACH and recycling, not spread. A resting BUY at p can only fill if the market later offers at or below p; the mirror test applies to the complement. Spread alone already failed to separate Gemini (wide, 24.4% reach), PMUS pregame (tight but frozen) and International (tight and churning, 80.6%).

recycling_resource_being_tested.not: literal PositionSplit behaviour -- the mechanism autopsy established that L5 never mints; the venue operator does, as matching plumbing
recycling_resource_being_tested.but: the economically equivalent resource: how often complementary or opposing demand arrives at a price that would let resting inventory recycle, measured as FIRST MAKER FILL -> OPPOSITE EXECUTABLE INTEREST -> MATCHED at 30s / 60s / 120s / remainder-of-market

if_a_cohort_qualifies: run the EXISTING frozen continuous-inventory L5 model in corrected shadow on it, preserving unequal sizing, same-side EXTEND runs, inventory imbalance, patient opposite acquisition, price-dependent sizing and TTE behaviour. It is NOT to be converted into equal-size YES/NO pair trading. Shadow only; no trading.
anti_fitting_commitments: thresholds above are fixed and will not be moved after seeing results
cohorts will not be pooled to manufacture a pass
near-misses are reported with the failing dimension named
the Gemini control keeps every prospective result exactly as recorded, including the economically bad shadow COMPLETE at pair basis 1.23
labels: Every fill, pair and conversion produced by this experiment is SHADOW/HYPOTHETICAL. No order exists; nothing is submitted, filled, settled or realized.

amendments_made_before_any_result_was_co.found: the selection iterated sportsMarketType families ALPHABETICALLY before applying the per-event cap, so football_game_first_quarter_total sorted ahead of the canonical game-level markets and filled the cap first.
amendments_made_before_any_result_was_co.evidence: the v1 NFL sample was 120 quarter/half TOTALS and 10 first-half spreads, with ZERO moneylines, ZERO full-game spreads and ZERO full-game totals -- while 6 moneylines, 111 full-game spreads and 136 full-game totals were in band and eligible.
amendments_made_before_any_result_was_co.fix: family priority is now explicit and follows what the experiment must report separately: winner/moneyline, then full-game spread, full-game total, then halves, then quarters.

amendments_made_before_any_result_was_co.found: the corrected priority list matched soccer's 'full_time_winner' but not football's 'full_game_winner'. The family key is sportsMarketType, and NFL's game winner is football_team_full_game_winner -- it matches neither that nor 'moneyline', which is the marketType. Moneylines still ranked last.

amendment_integrity: Both bugs were found by inspecting the SELECTED SAMPLE, not by looking at any outcome. No reach, movement, recycling or conversion figure had been computed for this slate when either fix was made. The superseded collections are retained rather than deleted. The qualification thresholds are unchanged.
